title: Finite affine etale covers are cofinal and stable under intersections
statement: For any scheme X and its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], define Cov(U,I,V,f) to mean U is affine, I is finite, every V_i is affine, and the sieve generated by f covers U. Every such family has affine iterated fibre products. Every cover of an affine U admits a refinement in Cov, with each member factoring through a member of the original cover.

source.place: Topologies Tag 0218; Schemes Tags 01I4/01JQ; Cohomology on Sites Tag 03F9 conditions (1),(2)

proof.text: Turn the product cone in Over U into its wide-pullback cone using Over.ConstructProducts.conesEquiv. Forget to schemes; this functor preserves the finite wide-pullback limit. Each object of the diagram is affine: the center is U and the legs are the V_i. Apply Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit.

Use ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff to construct a jointly surjective etale scheme cover of U.left. Its maps are open, so QuasiCompactCover.of_isOpenMap applies. Compactness of affine U and QuasiCompactCover.exists_hom give a finite affine refinement A and a morphism t to the original cover. Compose each A.f with U.hom to define the corresponding object W of X.Etale. The equations t.w₀ give factorization over U; A.cover.iUnion_range verifies covering. Empty U and empty finite covers are included.

proof_origin.place: Mathlib Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit and QuasiCompactCover.exists_hom; Stacks Tags 01I4/01JQ, 0218 and 03F9.

theorem finiteAffineEtaleCechCover_basis (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    (∀ (U : X.Etale) (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale)
      (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U), finiteAffineEtaleCechCover X U I V f →
      IsAffine U.left ∧ (∀ i : I, IsAffine (V i).left) ∧
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → I),
        IsAffine (piObj (fun j : Fin (p + 1) ↦ Over.mk (f (a j)))).left.left) ∧
    (∀ (U : X.Etale), IsAffine U.left →
      ∀ (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U),
        Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology U →
        ∃ (K : Type (u + 1)) (W : K → X.Etale) (g : ∀ k : K, W k ⟶ U),
          finiteAffineEtaleCechCover X U K W g ∧
            ∀ k : K, ∃ (i : I) (t : W k ⟶ V i), t ≫ f i = g k)
